request: Analyze GSE319093 for PMID 42356398 (ChREBP Is Dispensable for Myofiber Type Switch but Promotes Skeletal Muscle Regeneration.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, HISAT2, DESeq2), mouse gastrocnemius (GC), soleus (SOL), C2C12 myotubes
sequenced_sample_sets: Basal GC and SOL, F/F (ChREBP-flox) vs ChMKO (Mck-cre), n=5/group (S3.2.p2, Figure 3/S3)
Hypoxia 2 weeks vs normoxia, F/F and ChMKO GC, n=4/group (S2.3.p1, S3.4.p4-p5, Figure 5E-F)
Long-term high-fructose diet (3 months), F/F and ChMKO GC, n=4/group (S2.4.p1, S3.4.p7-p8, Figure 5G)
AAV-ChREBP vs AAV-CON GC at 14 dpi after cardiotoxin, n=5/group (S3.3.p2, Figure 4E-F)
C2C12 ChREBP overexpression vs vector, day 7 differentiation, n=4/group (S3.5.p2, Figure 6D-I)
final.exercise_component: Exercise appears only as a phenotypic readout: exhaustive weighted swimming test (S2.5) with plasma LDH/lactate at rest vs post-exercise (S3.1.p4, Figure 2D-E). No exercised muscle was sequenced; none of the GEO samples is an exercise or post-exercise sample.
final.primary_estimand: Paper's transcriptomic estimands are genotype (ChMKO vs F/F), hypoxia vs normoxia, HFrD vs chow, AAV-ChREBP vs AAV-CON, and Ch-OE vs vector. There is no exercise estimand in the RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: Hypo_F/F vs Norm_F/F; Hypo_ChMKO vs Hypo_F/F; Hypo_ChMKO vs Norm_ChMKO (S3.4.p4-p5; Figure 5F)
HFrD_F/F vs Norm_F/F (S3.4.p8; 483 DEGs); Hypo_F/F vs Norm_F/F (187 DEGs) (S3.4.p8)
C2C12 Ch-OE vs CON day 7 (S3.5.p2; 224 up DEGs)
final.paper_method: DESeq2, no multiple-testing correction, |log2FC| >= 1 and p < 0.05 (S2.13.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Read the paper md. S2.13.p1 describes RNA-seq (DESeq2; |log2FC|>=1, p<0.05, no FDR). Sequenced arms are genotype, hypoxia (S2.3), high-fructose diet (S2.4), AAV-ChREBP injury model (S2.10/S3.3) and C2C12 overexpression (S2.12/S3.5). The only exercise is the swimming endurance test (S2.5, S3.1.p4), measured by swim time and plasma LDH, with no sequencing. GEO characteristics confirm treatments are only none/Hypoxia/high-fructose diet/AAV/C2C12 OE; no metadata field mentions exercise, swimming, running or training.

GEO sample titles (GC-KO-59, GC-WT-57, SOL-..., H_KOc332, KO_C291, GC_MLXIPL_1, day7_OE_1) match the paper's ChMKO/F/F, hypoxia, HFrD, AAV-ChREBP and C2C12 sets
Matrix GSE319093_fpkm.anno.csv.gz columns GC_/SOL_ WT/KO are named in the metadata description field ('Column name in fpkm.anno.csv:...')

ownership.reasoning: Accession is stated in the Data Availability statement (DA.p1) and the sample sets match the paper's design. The fpkm.anno matrix (basal GC/SOL genotype set) is used to record alignment/matrix facts; the other three matrices (ChMKO_Expression_FPKM hypoxia/HFrD, AAV-ChREBP, C2C12_OE) contain no exercise samples either.

alignment.reasoning: Exact match on the matrix column name recorded in GEO 'description' ('Column name in fpkm.anno.csv:GC_KO_59'), never by position. Note GSM9510547 title says SOL-WT-59 but its description maps it to matrix column SOL_WT_69 (the matrix has no SOL_WT_59); the description is the submitter's explicit column map and is used. Metadata samples for the other three matrices stay unmatched by design.

final.paper_input: DESeq2 on counts (S2.13.p1); counts not deposited

matrix.reasoning: File named fpkm.anno; values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.45, median 0.21, NaN present), consistent with FPKM. The paper used DESeq2 on counts, which are not deposited. Matrix type is not ambiguous; it is not the reason the case stops.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in GSE319093: every sequenced sample is a sedentary/basal, hypoxia, high-fructose-diet, AAV-injury or C2C12 sample. Exercise in the paper (weighted swimming test, S2.5/S3.1.p4) was only a phenotypic readout and was never sequenced, so an exercise effect on gene expression cannot be identified.

candidates.value: geno KO vs WT (ChMKO vs F/F)

candidates.reason_rejected: hypoxic chamber exposure is an environmental stress, not exercise
gene overexpression after cardiotoxin injury, not exercise

design.reasoning: The request is the exercise effect on gene expression. Metadata treatment levels are none (38), Hypoxia (8), high-fructose diet (8), plus AAV and C2C12 groups; the paper's RNA-seq contrasts (S3.2.p2, S3.3.p2, S3.4.p4-p8, S3.5.p2) are all non-exercise. Manufacturing a contrast from these would answer a different question.

discrepancies.paper: Exercise (swimming endurance) assessed only phenotypically (S2.5, S3.1.p4); RNA-seq covers genotype, hypoxia, HFrD, AAV-ChREBP, C2C12 OE
discrepancies.data: GEO metadata has no exercise/swim/training samples
